headline: City Council reviews the Flock Safety program, including contracts, amendments, renewals, purchase orders, and policies.
summary: The Malden City Council will receive a full review of the Flock Safety program from the City Solicitor, Police Chief, Malden Police Community Advisory Council, Controllers Office, and other City officials. The review covers all related contracts, exhibits, amendments, renewals, purchase orders, policies, and agreements.
